subject: Proposal: Rotor weekly demo rotation (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>, Aisha Yamada <aisha.yamada@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Rotor weekly demo rotation (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Liam / Aisha —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — great conversation and helpful context on Novacorp's integration timeline and data residency needs. Per our call, next step is a technical deep-dive/demo with your infra and product teams focused on:

  - deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
  - network/firewall requirements and KMS options
  - expected QPS and latency SLOs for your pilot

To make this easiest for the cross-region stakeholders, I put together a proposed rotating weekly slot plan (attached) so everyone gets one friendly time window on alternating weeks instead of always forcing one team to do nights. Attachment: Rotor_demo_schedule_v1.xlsx (contains proposed 8-week rotation). Also attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP_Novacorp_v0.3.docx).

Proposed rotation (high level) — we can tweak:
  1) Week 1 (US-friendly): 16:00 PDT / 00:00 BST (next day) / 08:00 SGT
  2) Week 2 (EU-friendly): 10:00 PDT / 18:00 BST / 02:00 SGT
  3) Week 3 (APAC-friendly): 07:00 PDT / 15:00 BST / 23:00 SGT

Two asks:
  - Can you confirm any hard constraints (blocked days, NO-GO windows) for the teams?
  - Which of the three rotation weeks is preferable to start with for Novacorp (US/EU/APAC)?

If helpful I can run a quick calendar poll (Vivek can set that up) and then we can lock the recurring invite.

Next steps after scheduling: share a one-page agenda and identify the tech owners who should attend (e.g., infra lead, security/compliance, and an engineer familiar with the integration).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Rotor_demo_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), MAP_Novacorp_v0.3.docx (doc)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aisha Yamada <aisha.yamada@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposal: Rotor weekly demo rotation (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks Priyom — good write-up and the rotation idea sounds fair. Quick context on our side:

  - EU product team prefers late mornings / early afternoons CET (roughly 14:00–17:00 BST)
  - US solutions/engineering are typically available after 15:00 PDT (end-of-day US window)
  - APAC (SG/HK) wants to avoid anything after 09:30 SGT; they can do early mornings but only 1x every two weeks for deep-dive attendees

Hard constraints: no meetings for core infra team on Fridays (they do maintenance), and Monday mornings are tough for product.

If we map that to your three-week draft, it looks workable if we ensure the APAC weeks are spaced and not back-to-back. For example: start with Week 1 (US-friendly) the first session, then rotate to EU-friendly, then APAC-friendly two weeks later.

One practical ask: can you make the APAC slot start at 08:30 SGT (rather than 08:00) on APAC weeks? That gives our HK folks time to join before their day ramps.

I'll loop in our infra lead, Rajesh (rajesh.patel@novacorp.com), in the planning invite once we confirm.

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Integrations | Novacorp
liam.oconnor@novacorp.com

Subject: Re: Proposal: Rotor weekly demo rotation (US/EU/APAC)

Liam — appreciate the constraints, that helps. Quick internal note / proposal:

  - Start with Week 1 (US-friendly) on 2025-06-25 to get momentum with the core infra folks.
  - Week 2 (EU-friendly) the following week, then APAC-friendly session on week 3 but shift APAC start to 08:30 SGT per your ask.
  - We'll treat APAC weeks as lighter-attendance deep dives (engineer + product + security on-call) every other APAC slot so they are not overloaded.
  - Avoid Fridays and Monday mornings for recurring slots.

Operationally: Vivek will create a Doodle/Calendly poll and we'll include a one-pager agenda + a short pre-read (2 slides) for the infra team. Priyom — can you confirm the tech owners from Redwood who should be on each session (I recommend: Vivek for infra/network, me for product/roadmap, and a solutions engineer for the demo).

I also edited the Rotor_demo_schedule_v1.xlsx with our suggested start dates and will drop an updated copy into the calendar when Vivek creates the poll.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Please vote on the link below and add any no-go dates in the comments. Once we have a consensus I'll send the recurring invites and include the attachments / pre-read.

Calendar poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/rotor-demo-ACb12
Updated schedule (attached): Rotor_demo_schedule_v1.xlsx (tab: v2 - start dates adjusted)
Mutual action plan: MAP_Novacorp_v0.3.docx (added expected owners column)

Next steps:
  - Please vote on the poll by EOD Thu 19 Jun so we can start on 25 Jun.
  - Priyom & Marissa: confirm Redwood attendees for the first three sessions.
  - Liam: please add Rajesh and any other infra contacts to the poll so invites land in their calendars.

Thanks — Vivek
